later_publication_notes: The initial revision covers the original mapping. Later evidence is content-hash bound. Exact signal conversion, scalar duration hoisting and train reciprocal hoisting reuse historical timings only after exact public executable identity. Scalar-filter and train admissions bind both reference and candidate. These admissions add no physical measurement records. Train remains partially qualified with its inherited warm-start duty failure. Expanded line-mode observations are native-only, preserve baseline faults and original passes, and add no target measurements. Partial working status now records board-evidence location explicitly; line has none. The bounded-line compiler option is experimental with native output/clock evidence and exact public/private target-image binding only. Its target execution flag is false and no CPU measurement is added; it does not reuse physical-original identity flags. Wave3 adds four exact native-only spellings: onepole~ and slide~ retain six mathematical accuracy failures, while delta~ and sah~ pass their declared independent gates. Ten target forms compile; none executed. The isolated integer abs runtime fix adds no DSP adapter or CPU measurement. Canonical sah and codebox sah remain unverified. The experimental default-off Float32 onepole clamp option adds a finite stored-value proof and exact public/private compiled pairs, retaining all five native accuracy failures. The historical first corrected Float32 recurrence remained private after a large-finite input fault; the separately qualified recovery profile was published later. No target execution or CPU measurement is added. The experimental stable-onepole profile adds corrected Float32 coefficient/history and finite recovery in three exact FX graphs. The strict baseline retains its five accuracy failures; the corrected declared native gates pass. New explicit15-case public CLI selection is not additional program coverage. Finite safety, bounded accuracy, compiled resources and target execution remain separate; no CPU measurement or alias qualification is added. Eligible regenerated flat Main/FX graphs now receive per-instance stable-onepole updates after all42 prepared files match a fresh local export. Ten additional composed native programs pass, and four fresh target compilations retain Context/member layouts. Fixed fractional cache comparisons retain Double work. These observations add no raw timing measurement, target execution, performance percentage or alias inheritance. XIAO wave4 adds 15 exact patcher/codebox/member names with scoped independent model output evidence. Their identities are checked against explicit observation selectors; no alias status is inferred. Existing 154 AMOLED timing measurements and primary choices are unchanged; new same-module controls have no saved-time percentage. Gen metadata and native History programs remain separate from this RNBO table. The separately recorded XIAO dbtoa Float32 experiment adds five matched timing measurements (aggregate plus four input vectors), retaining all 154 historical AMOLED measurements. Changed rounding and exact-graph admission remain explicit.
